how: A member proposes the flag and supplies its revised coordinates before others announce completion.
Calls recruit builders for the flag, while later proposals seek kindred sports communities for additional artwork.
A defense request receives the bare acceptance On it rather than a negotiated exchange.
Participants judge designs too ambitious, too large for the available space, or beyond their available manpower.
The room proposes and revises its flag, nameplate, hearts, and local emblems without giving every proposal equal support.
Builders announce the flag finished and later report nameplate completion and a smaller emblem under construction.
Coordinates, requested templates, and corrected scales turn proposed emblems into instructions others can follow.
Members run an overnight protection script, explain pixel correction, and share another maintenance script that a moderator runs.
The record shows a host-side vote and a request for a representative but cannot test the cross-room prevalence claim or establish whether Maryland selected canvas leadership.
A requested chat is opened and joined, while design discussion returns to Reddit without revealing the chat deliberation.
statement: Moving coordination into a chat and returning selected plans to the public thread

how: Participants prioritise defense, report night duty, repair vandalism, and protect completed work rather than treating completion as the end of effort.
Members distinguish unauthorised envoys and errant placers from collective intent, and one defender acknowledges having mistaken construction for damage.
Participants bargain over borders, proposed relocation, protection, and additions, with one Swedish objection reversed after a reported vote.
An already placed flag becomes enclosed by a stronger neighbour whose claimed authority governs additions and later applicants.
When a mark occupies another group's claimed territory, proposed additions require host permission as well as agreement among their designers.
Negotiation can allocate unequal approval rights, leaving guests able to offer labour but unable to grant neighbouring space.
A visiting negotiator carries relocation proposals and reports changing priorities from an external organising chat.
Members disown an unsanctioned envoy, while a visiting negotiator asks who can represent the group.
Negotiation exposes disputed credentials and requests for representation, but the record does not establish universal compliance or a refusal to honour every treaty.
An explicit retaliation call receives refusal, and later participants keep their pixels inside the border and refuse further encroachment.
Requests for repayment and overnight guarding receive commitments and reported repairs, while other applicants encounter refusals or conditional offers.
Spare pixels are offered to a neighbour only after the contributor's own flag is safe, making reciprocal labour conditional rather than automatic.
A reported mutual-defense deal and a jointly proposed heart provide the minimal coalition form without establishing a formal council.
Loss of a heart produces a proposed transplant and a suggestion to seek rebuilding locations, without a demonstrated completed relocation.
Judging strength insufficient can lead to bargaining over borders and refusing relocation rather than leaving the existing flag.
Participants recruit regional pride, Lord Calvert's arms, and a rewritten state song to interpret their shared pixel work.
Shared regional identification does not imply support for every local emblem, since a flag contributor explicitly refuses the university mark.
The university replacement proposal and reported sports attack do not establish a pre-canvas quarrel adopted by this room.
Named sports targets and reported attackers do not establish a pre-existing tie explicitly given as this room's reason for attacking.
Moderators consolidate live discussion, while later members dispute continued alliance talk and propose filters or another subreddit.
A post-event fake sister-city headline does not establish that the host was keyed as April Fools play during the one-day licence.
Participants celebrate the finished flag, thank guards and allies, and describe the alliance as the event's best story.
Closure prompts reports of survival and recollections of cleaning, threats, agreement, and the king's defense.
Participants carry the tie into travel invitations, flair, gifts, and a related-subreddit petition that a moderator grants.
Carrying a canvas friendship into the host subreddit remains contested even when moderators accept a concrete request to retain it.
Retelling early threats as eventual agreement does not show a dispute over a corrected canvas copy or competing preserved versions.
A resident reports discovering the subreddit through its canvas effort, making audience return distinct from preserving the completed mark.
statement: Bringing people into the home subreddit through its canvas work

how: The record contains calls to retaliate and replace another university's mark, without proving that these calls produced a sustained raid.
A reply mocks a Swedish threat through a furniture taunt, establishing a small verbal contest rather than a documented prolonged campaign.
The flag proposal supplies a concrete object for subsequent recruitment and participation, without establishing the proposer as an appointed leader.
Calls, reported placing, and completion are visible, but the record does not trace each builder's participation to reading a particular call.
Reporting nameplate completion explicitly changes the stated task to defense or colour changes.
Concern about approaching Swedish pixels is followed by an explicit proposal to ask Sweden not to invade.
Disavowing an expansion envoy explicitly accompanies keeping pixels inside the accepted border.
Scripts explicitly serve upkeep, but the record does not establish that manual defense exhaustion caused their adoption.
A completion announcement receives an explicit celebration of the finished flag.
Celebration and recollection coexist, but the replies do not establish that celebration caused people to preserve a separate visual record.
Plans to retain the relationship already appear before closure, so recording the finished work is not a necessary precursor to continuity.
A proposed crab is made dependent on obtaining a usable template, which another participant later supplies.
The sleep-time defense call receives a bare On it answer in its reply tree.
A smaller protected group also supplies help after its own work is safe, rather than only soliciting outside hands under strain.
The starter explicitly recalls negotiating mutual help, and later speakers describe their defense as repayment for protection.
Retaliation is proposed after a flag already stands, without evidence that recruitment itself caused members to attack.
The retaliation call is directly answered by both bare refusal and a proposal to reserve clicks for defense.
The attack call and later negotiations are visible, but no cited turn establishes that the former prompted the latter.
A retaliation call and a taunt occur in different exchanges without a cited passage establishing the proposed causal connection.
Mutual defense is explicit, but its emergence cannot be attributed solely to a shared attack rather than protection, retained space, and gratitude.
The moderator cites improving coordination and members contest later alliance talk, leaving recruitment-driven flooding only partly supported as their common cause.
Event-specific venues may lose their purpose after closure while established neighbours restrict canvas talk, limiting where reciprocal gestures can persist.
